title: Watchlist: a removed stock comes back after a reload
signature: watchlist | removal not persisted | removed ticker ≠ absent after reload
prerequisite: MarketFlow demo opened with ?defect=watchlist-remove-not-saved; empty watchlist
scope: Watchlist page only. Removing from the board star or the stock page is not affected.
steps: First, sign in with the QA test account.
On the market board, add ACB and FPT to the watchlist with the star buttons.
Open the watchlist. Both stocks are listed.
Now remove FPT with its star. The row disappears, and the count shows one stock.
actual: FPT is back on the watchlist. The removal was never saved.
expected: FPT stays removed after a reload, and the count stays at one stock.
